scope.organization_scope_requirement: organization context is required when the governed record is organization-bound
scope.environment_scope_requirement: policy activation and exceptions are environment-specific
scope.policy_activation_requirement: requires Product and Safety Authority plus Platform Operator approval before enforcement

disposition_preconditions: The tenant-scoped retention profile reference is active and approved.
No active legal hold applies to the source record or linked evidence.
The required approval, audit, recovery, and exception references are present.
A future authoritative Go workflow has evaluated the policy server-side.
prohibited_behavior: No client, advisory service, object-store lifecycle rule, or background worker may delete authoritative evidence or audit state without the future server-authoritative disposition workflow.
No retention duration is implied by this baseline artifact.

legal_hold.precedence_rule: An active legal hold blocks disposition and any transformation that would impair preservation of the held source record.
legal_hold.activation_requirement: requires accountable hold authority, reason reference, scope reference, created timestamp, and audit record
legal_hold.release_requirement: requires accountable release authority, release reason reference, timestamp, and immutable audit record
prohibited_behavior: No automated retention job may release or bypass an active hold.
No redaction may overwrite a held source evidence object.

redaction.source_immutability_rule: The original authoritative evidence object and digest remain immutable; a redacted result is a separately identified derivative with lineage and its own digest.
redaction.approval_requirement: requires applicable tenant authority and, where safety/recovery evidence is affected, Product and Safety Authority review
prohibited_behavior: No in-place modification of source evidence.
No redaction may erase audit or recovery lineage.

export_access.manifest_requirement: Every future portable export must contain an evidence export manifest referencing the approved policy snapshot and approval record.
prohibited_behavior: No Keycloak claim alone grants export access.
No export endpoint may return an object outside local Go/PostgreSQL authorization and tenant scope.

audit_event_requirements: tenant and organization scope where applicable
no evidence bytes, secret values, tokens, private keys, or unbounded raw payloads
audit_and_recovery.recovery_requirement: A recovery/export drill preserves the policy version, retention profile reference, hold-state snapshot, redaction lineage, approval reference, source/restored checksums, exceptions, operator, and reviewer references.
audit_and_recovery.immutability_requirement: A verification, recovery, or export failure must not silently modify authoritative record state.

conflict_resolution.rule: The most restrictive applicable legal, safety, contractual, or tenant requirement governs until an accountable authority records a resolution.

implementation_deferrals: No retention duration, scheduler, lifecycle rule, deletion operation, legal-hold table, legal-hold API, redaction service, export API, export approval workflow, or database migration is implemented by this contract.
No RustFS object is read, copied, redacted, archived, deleted, or lifecycle-configured by this contract.
No acceptance or pilot runtime configuration changes are made by this contract.
